segments.text: Welcome to your daily Robotics news digest from September 26th, 2026.
Today we're diving into deep discussions on ROS inference, a sweet video, and some exciting developments in the field.
From Planet ROS, ROS Discourse General: Question on local vs. remote inference placement for perception tasks.

This discourse seeks input regarding the placement of perception and higher-level artificial intelligence inference tasks for robots, exploring whether local, remote, or cloud execution is fixed or dynamic based on variables like deadlines, network conditions, and compute load.

Participants shared experiences concerning latency and compute contention issues encountered during these placements and the subsequent solutions implemented, including feedback on offloading and subsequent retraction of inference.
This exchange focuses exclusively on perception and artificial intelligence tasks, excluding safety-critical systems.
The discussion provides insights into optimizing computational workflow for robotic perception systems.
From IEEE Spectrum - Robotics, "Video Friday: Life’s Better With a Little Robot Goose"
presents a weekly selection of robotics videos and an upcoming events calendar.
This collection features diverse robotics topics including autonomous drones walking robots dexterous hands and underwater manipulation showcasing recent advancements in the field.
The content includes examples such as Skydio's F10 drone walking robots developed from the Honda P2 and underwater arm collaboration exploring physical AI and humanoid integration.
These projects demonstrate ongoing research into advanced robotic capabilities and physical artificial intelligence.
The ongoing research highlights significant progress in autonomous systems and physical interaction technologies.
Future developments in physical AI and robotic integration are expected to drive further technological advancement in the industry.
